equity.feed: Yahoo chart public adjusted OHLC research proxy

adaptation_identity: Atlas independently specified, source-inspired rule families; not faithful reproduction of any professional trader's discretionary decisions or published returns
split: After 200 benchmark bars: first 50% development, next 25% validation, final 25% holdout. Same calendar for all symbols in a market/timeframe. Each segment starts with independent cash; no position or pending-order leakage across segments.
position_allocation: At entry, one-sixth of available marked account equity, capped by cash, no leverage, fixed alphabetic tie-break; exits before entries at same next-open timestamp
fills: Completed bar signals execute at next available shared-calendar open with adverse slippage. Gaps do not fabricate bars. Stop gaps fill at worse open; stop/target same bar chooses stop first. No close-derived entry is filled on that same close.
selection: For each market/timeframe select at most one configuration using development and validation at the baseline adverse-cost scenario. Freeze its identity before computing holdout outcomes. No switching based on holdout results.
frequency_reporting: Report entries/month and active days. Daily swing survivors are not described as all-day scalpers. Historical selection is not clean prospective out-of-sample evidence.
entry_exit_details: Exact predetermined rules in app/strategy_lab/broad_strategy_lab.py; generic research adaptations. Mean-reversion branches use a 3-ATR entry-relative protective stop; no fixed take profit; exit via their named mean reversion condition or 5/8/10-bar time exit. Trend branches use 2/3-ATR stops, selected 3-ATR targets or 3-ATR close-updated trailing stops and 15/20/30/120-bar time exits. TURNAROUND_TUESDAY buys the next Tuesday open after a declining Monday and exits next Wednesday open, not a claimed original close-auction reproduction.
scope_note: Original frozen protocol; source SHA recorded at first run. Current implementation adds per-symbol warmup and CLI. Initial 48 symbol/timeframe windows already began after each symbol warmup; outputs unchanged. Supplemental long study used per-symbol warmup.
